title: Residues of a Three Color Quotient

algebra.expression: A = T[-2.4deg] N_even K_index H_[0.32,1.55]^4 P[outline](G)
algebra.interpretation: Every tile is lifted into four nested scales. Even echoes become normal fields while odd echoes retain closed boundaries, producing a visible alternation between discrete enclosure and differential expansion.
algebra.order: Read operators right to left; tool flow arrays execute top to bottom. P changes paint, C changes shape, K maps colors, H creates concentric scale copies, N samples normal marks, B samples tangent or vertical marks, T is a small affine transform.
